title: Senior React Native Mobile App Developer
description:
Go.Compare has been part of the Future family since 2021 and has been helping people make smarter financial decisions since 2006. Built on the belief that choosing the right product is about more than just price, we're committed to giving customers the confidence to compare with clarity. By putting people first and making comparison simple, we help millions make informed choices every day.
We’re building world-class mobile experiences that delight our users and drive real business impact. Our team thrives on clean, scalable code, pragmatic problem solving, and continuous learning. We’re now looking for a Senior React Native Engineer to take a leading role in delivering apps that work flawlessly across iOS and Android. This is more than just a development role - it’s an opportunity to influence architecture and shape the direction of our mobile platform as we move into the App space.
What you'll do
As a Senior React Native Engineer, you’ll bring strong technical leadership alongside hands-on development expertise. You’ll design scalable architecture, drive best practices, and work closely with product managers, designers, and backend teams to deliver seamless mobile experiences. This is a high-impact role where you’ll own critical parts of the codebase, solve complex technical challenges, and actively support the growth of less experienced engineers. Your opinion matters within your role - your peers will look to you as a key player within the team. You will be expected to help make key decisions that are inline with the technical roadmap and platform. You should be able to clearly explain those decisions to the wider team (both technical and non-technical).
What you’ll bring

• Experience in mobile development specifically in React Native and cross-platform development

• Strong expertise in TypeScript with advanced type patterns, generics, and type-safe development practices

• Deep knowledge of state management including Redux Toolkit, Redux Saga, and Zustand for complex application state

• Cross-platform understanding of iOS and Android platform differences, native modules, and device compatibility

• Strong testing background using Jest, React Native Testing Library, test-driven development, and maintaining high code coverage

• Proven debugging skills with React Native profiling tools, Sentry crash reporting, and performance optimisation techniques

• REST API integration expertise using Axios, authentication handling, error management, and data transformation ▪ DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines, app store deployments, Expo development, and Firebase integration

• Excellent collaboration, communication, and mentorship skills for working with cross-functional teams and guiding junior developers

What we offer

• Uncapped leave

• Enhanced parental leave

• Discounted rates with Dental care and Private Medical care

• When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus

• Refer a friend scheme - with payment following the successful hire.

• Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programmes

• Opportunity to purchase shares in Future, with our Share Incentive Plan

• Salary sacrifice Pension scheme up to 5% match

• Free drinks and snacks in our offices

The expected range for this role is £55,000- £65,000
This is a UK remote working role
Internal job family level Technology 5
Inclusion and Diversity at Future
At Future, we’re working to attract, retain and foster diverse talent, educating our colleagues in the importance of diversity, and review our internal processes so that they remain as free from bias as possible. We recognise that, in order to reach diverse communities through our content, we must first ensure ours is a culture in which diversity can thrive.
Find out more about Our Future, Our Responsibility on our website.

SimpliFed is looking for a Director of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) to own the full revenue cycle end-to-end - and to build it properly, not just run it.
This is a hands-on leadership role at a company in the middle of meaningful change. We are migrating to a new EHR (Healthie), rebuilding our configuration in Candid Health, and establishing a clean, trustworthy data foundation underneath both. The person in this seat will lead that work, then own the operating rhythm that comes after it.
We are looking for a true RCM expert - someone who has personally configured payer rules, worked denials, defended a cash forecast, and can tell us what we are doing wrong. You will be the company’s authority on revenue cycle, and you will be given the mandate to act like it.
What you’ll own

•
End-to-end revenue cycle. Eligibility and benefits verification, charge capture, coding, claim submission, denial management, appeals, AR follow-up, patient billing, and cash posting.

•
The Candid Health build. Own configuration, payer rules, fee schedules, and claim edits. Establish a monitoring cadence and modify rules based on what the data actually shows - not what was assumed at setup.

•
EHR transition. Serve as the revenue cycle lead on the Healthie implementation. Ensure clinical documentation, encounter data, and charge flow map cleanly into billing, and manage the cleanup and resolution of legacy claims from the prior system.

•
Data integrity. Establish and maintain a single source of truth for payer, plan, provider, and contract data. Clean data is a precondition for everything else here, and it is a core part of this job.

What success looks like

First 90 days: You are learning quickly, have assessed the current state, identified where revenue is leaking, and produced a prioritized remediation plan with owners and dates.

•
First six months: Candid is configured correctly and monitored, the Healthie transition is complete from a billing standpoint, legacy claims are resolved or you have a plan of action, and reporting is trusted.

•
Ongoing: Clean claim rate, first-pass yield, denial rate, days in AR, and net collection rate are measured, improving, and forecastable.

• 7+ years in healthcare revenue cycle, with 3+ years leading a team or function

• Deep professional (physician/practitioner) billing experience - not solely facility/hospital

• Hands-on ownership of a modern billing or claims platform (Candid Health strongly preferred; Waystar, Availity, Office Ally, Change/Optum, or similar considered)

• Comfort working with messy data - able to reconcile, validate, and build structure where none exists

• Direct experience managing commercial payer escalations, underpayments, and performance issues

Preferred

description:
Our merchants are the heart and soul of our business, and the Merchant Success Team at Loop exists to optimize the value of the Loop partnership to their business. This begins with the merchant onboarding experience and continues through ongoing support and strategic account management.
As a Mid-Market Merchant Success Manager at Loop , you will own a portfolio of growing merchants and help them realize measurable value from their partnership with Loop . Through consultative relationships, strong prioritization, repeatable playbooks, and scalable engagement, you will drive retention, product adoption, and expansion across your book of business.
This role requires the ability to balance proactive strategy with portfolio efficiency, use data and health signals to focus time where it will have the greatest impact, and deliver a consistently strong merchant experience at scale.
Right away, we’ve listed what we think you’ll be spending your time on. We’re growing fast, and growth means the challenges we’ll work on together will change as we lead Loop through new and different phases.
This is an indispensable role with us, so we’ll be looking for you to have examples of when you’ve tackled these challenges throughout your career. We’ve laid out the experience we think is important to set you up for success in this role. But, we appreciate that different humans will solve problems in different ways, so we don’t expect you to fit exactly in a box of requirements.

At Loop , we're intentional about how we work so everyone can do their best work. We call this our Blended Working Environment. Our team is based across our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, as well as Hub and Secluded locations through the United States, select Canadian provinces, the United Kingdom, and select Australian states.
For this position, we are looking for a teammate located in the United States.
Challenge: Be accountable for revenue retention and expansion goals for Loop ’s mid-market merchants.

• Your main priority is to make our merchants successful, and you’ll use any and all of your resources to make it happen.

• Be accountable for revenue retention, renewals, expansion, and retraction mitigation across your assigned portfolio.

• Use merchant goals, health signals, engagement, product usage, and renewal timing to prioritize your book of business and determine where proactive intervention will have the greatest impact.

• Lead complex renewal and commercial conversations, clearly articulating Loop 's value and competitive differentiation to stakeholders across the merchant's organization.

• You’ll partner cross-functionally with Account Executives to cross-sell our products to your existing merchant base.

Your Experience:

• 3+ years of customer success or account management experience with mid-market or enterprise businesses for B2B SaaS products. If you have experience working with the ecommerce industry, that is a huge differentiator for us!

• You’ve managed accounts for a long enough period of time that you oversaw the renewal process with them, and have successfully renewed many accounts.

• You know what it’s like to be accountable for revenue goals, and you’ve accomplished (or exceeded!) them in the past.

• You have tried to find true ways to uncover and close new opportunities with accounts, and are willing to share a few examples with us.

Challenge: Build impactful consultative relationships with your merchants to drive additional value through Loop .

• Host quarterly business reviews with your key accounts, showing up with content that aligns merchants priorities to Loop 's capabilities and the outcomes that matter most to their business.

• Engage in regular, creative touchpoints with your accounts to get in front of any issues prior to renewal and avoid merchant churn.
